name: Noah Keen
bio: Noah Keen was born on October 10, 1920 in Cincinnati, Ohio, USA as Edward Ellsworth Keen. He served as a bombardier in WWII. He was an actor and director, known for Battle for the Planet of the Apes (1973), The Six Million Dollar Man (1974) and Gable and Lombard (1976). He was married to Gerrianne Raphael and Barbara Corday. He died on March 24, 2019 in Harlem, Manhattan, New York City, New York, USA.
